decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's thermoforming material range and had their own page through 2019, so keeping them is cheap and sensible.
PETG thermoforming blanks are a core consumable for dental labs, sit at the center of the firm's thermoforming portfolio, and are likely to sell steadily.
The UV-curing lacquer is a supporting lab material that was only mentioned on the website, but it complements the firm's lab and earmold processes at little maintenance cost.
Custom hearing protection earmolds still appeared through 2019 even after the wider earmold line was removed, so they remain a viable niche despite some risk of following that line off the market.
